headline: Sales growth broadens into margin and earnings gains
summary_short: Chewy's fiscal Q1 2026 net sales rose 7.7% y/y to $3,357.2M, with gross margin up 50bps to 30.1% and GAAP diluted EPS of $0.23 (+53.3% y/y) on record profitability and nearly 200,000 net customer additions.
summary_long: Net sales grew 7.7% y/y to $3,357.2M on active-customer growth (+3.6% to 21.5M) and higher spend per customer ($597, +2.4%), with Autoship penetration rising to 84.4% of sales from 82.2%. Gross margin expanded 50bps to 30.1%, driving GAAP operating income up 67% y/y to $128.5M and net income up 52% to $94.8M ($0.23 diluted EPS, +53.3% y/y); adjusted EBITDA rose $60.4M y/y to $253.1M (7.5% margin, +130bps). Cash fell to $485.2M from $860.1M at fiscal year-end, on $200M of buybacks, a $174.8M acquisition, and working-capital swings, partly offset by $108.5M of operating cash flow ($70.8M free cash flow). No forward guidance was issued for Q2 or the full year in this release.
